player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing {colour} ({piece}) in a game of Othello.
Your goal is to have more pieces of your color on the board by the end of the game.
On your turn, place a piece such that it flanks one or more of your opponent's pieces-in any direction (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal)-between your new piece and another of your existing pieces. All flanked opponent pieces will be flipped to your color.
Provide your move in the format '[row, col]'.

game_message.must_skip: Player {pid} ({piece}) e sega ni vakadidike ni kena ibuli kei na qai vakaloloma.
